nodes.label: ADR 0130: The same file on two computers is one song, with a copy on each
nodes.rationale: When a song is added to the collection on the laptop and sent to the desktop, it should appear as one song with copies on both computers, not as duplicates. Previously, the incoming folder scan made every new file a new song, never checking if the collection already had that song on another computer. This decision ensures that a file matching by size and name across computers becomes the computer's copy of an existing song, with the older song staying and the other computer's song joining it.

nodes.label: Same file matching: size and name criteria
nodes.rationale: A file is considered the same if it has the same size and the same name, or the name with ' (2)' appended (as added by GLUE Home's incoming folder when a name is taken). This differs from matching by tags and length (trackKey), which would treat different formats of the same recording as one song—a job for Duplicates instead.

nodes.label: Older song stays during copy joining
nodes.rationale: When two copies of the same file are detected on different computers, both computers must agree on which song stays. The older song (earlier addedAt, then lower id) is kept, and only the computer whose song is younger performs the join. This prevents each computer from dropping the song the other kept.

nodes.label: Track absorption during copy folding
nodes.rationale: When folding an existing pair, the younger computer's song's analysis becomes this computer's analysis of the song. Playlist places, rating, notes, tags, and Prepare move over via absorbTracks, and the younger computer's row is deleted. If the file came by scan, the other computer's analysis of the same bytes is kept as this computer's too, avoiding re-analysis.

nodes.label: Conditions where copy joining does not occur
nodes.rationale: Copy joining only applies to shared collections. It does not join a second copy of a song already on this computer, files of a different size, or songs in non-shared collections.

nodes.label: Backup before joining multiple copies
nodes.rationale: If more than 10 pairs of the same file are detected at once (e.g., on the first open after this change), a backup is created before joining, via backupBefore('join-copies').
